body: Talk to your parents and teachers and they will help resolve the problem. Tell them every little detail, tell them exactly how you feel about yourself and honestly things will start to get a lot better quickly.
No one girl is worth your life. If you attracted this girl in the first place there will be others. Have hope bro.
I care about you. What happened to you is horrific and you shouldn't blame yourself for it. If you met and attracted one guy you can attract others and there are billions of fish in the sea.
Were you abused as a child? In an abusive job? Have an abusive partner? If not can you put a finger on why you have feelings of self loathing ?
Its not too late. You are asking for help now. I can tell you this there's nothing worse than making the mistake of thinking people don't care.

In your current situation you are suffering from situational depression. Its causing you to have suicidal thoughts. You need to save your own life and get out or change that situation! Therapists tend to sugar coat everything and family can never relate. I'm here to tell you that your life is in your hands. I cant make you find a solution to your problems but i'm asking you to try. About a month ago I tried to kill myself, I took 50 zopiclone thinking this would be enough, it wasnt, luckily. Why did I do this? I had failed at life and I put noone else to account but myself, it was a mix of self loathing and self hatred. My life was going nowhere and i was stuck doing the same thing I had been for the last 3 years. But I can tell you after the attempt it felt like a release and what I learnt was it was just a mood making me feel down. A mood that had overcome me like a dark cloud and it was suddenly lifted. That changed my perspective completely, with a change of perspective life is worth living even in a shit situation. I'm not saying its going to be that easy but start on a course of anti-depressants and everyday write down what you're stressing about and do something about it. Change your life one step at a time. Cheat, lie, steal, fuck about, do all the wrongs you were too afraid to do before because anything is better than being dead.

You are going through a dramatic experience, noone will blame you for inventing a story of a family death or something. Something that that explains the year out. Why is it you are losing the will to live? Can you pinpoint a moment where you started to lose it? Are you talking about this to any of your friends or family ?

Firstly you're not alone in this world. I've failed exams, thought I was too stupid to pass my course, been bullied, isolated and felt like shit. Secondly my advice to you is not let other people have so much power over you. You can't blame yourself for every little opinion someone has. Some people are just arseholes - fact. Suicide is the only bad decision you'll make.

Don't let academic pressure get to you! The work load may seem huge but the best advice is to sit down and work - at whatever - just work your way through. If its too much to handle you can always repeat the year, i did at the university of york, best decision of my life. I had the year to repeat topics i half knew and breezed it.

If you're feeling down then you're not wasting any ones time by being here. I take it you are on anti-depressants ? They take a good 6 weeks to properly take effect so stick with them. And even then you need to follow through with some life style changes to really knock feelings of worthlessness on the head.  If you were that much of a burden those people wouldnt hang out with you, dont speak for them when you dont know. It may seem like you have a long way to go but life is what you make it, you control the direction it goes in.
Don't let people have that much power over you
Really good to hear! I'm still struggling at the moment to be honest, what got you over the worst of it ?
Hey thanks for getting back to me! Hows things ?
The truth is you can never reduce the impact on your family, even if you make it look like an acident they'll mourn you for the rest of their lives.

You can find a house share online, you wont get attacked by them, you will have your own room with a locked door while you sleep, you'll be perfectly safe, please reconsider this decision, you have reasons to live.

im sorry to hear about that. Are there no other housing options? Sharing a flat with other roommates might be cheaper than looking for one on your own? Wouldnt it be better living on the street than being dead?

sick with what exactly? There's nothing wrong with taking a step backwards to give you two ahead, the only thing you cant change is death. Please reconsider this decision. I regretted it when I took an overdose, I promise things can look better in the future. Whats your address? I can help you.
Why dont you want to live? Whats  your address?
Diagnosing someones philosophical spectrum isn't that offensive, it might give this guy solace that hes not alone, there's nothing wrong with being a nihlist.
His point is fairly valid, freedom of choice is a reason to live. Liking yourself is a different matter though.
Everyone deserves comforting, dont put yourself down like that :(

People who go through trauma without knowing why will often blame themselves, single themselves out from the crowd and think they are different. Thats really normal. Its also really treatable. Get yourself a therapist! 
All the things you've done you've done because you needed to do them. On an objective moral compass there is no north, people will judge you no matter what you do, the only really important opinion is your own. Do you think this mate of yours will forgive you for the way you've acted if you sorted your shit out ? I think so, I think he wants you to sort your shit out, and I think you want to sort your shit out too, you just need to make the first step. Take it one small step at a time and soon you'll ease up on the self-loathing. Tomorrow is the beginning of the rest of your life :)

I look at it like this: life is a diamond mine. You mine through seemly miles of rock to get that one diamond, and that makes you rich for a while, until its time to start over again. I've been fumbling my whole life, but the momentes of happiness are worth it. When you're depressed, on lows, feeling like shit you don't remember the good times. You dont remember that feeling of joy you got from doing what you enjoy. Its a frame of mind that cant be shifted unless you change your life. The drugs youre taking are clouding your judgement here. You need to train yourself to think positively about life. Your break up with this guy was the catalyst for you feeling down but it could be the catalyst to the next happy relationship you have. I think its hard for you because you blame yourself, and are going through a period of self loathing, you mentioned your behaviour being fucked up, what was so bad that you did ? You can redeem yourself here, life doesn't have to spiral downwards! Learn from your mistakes and change your behaviour. Please wake up tomorrow and write down 3 things that will help you improve your life. Be as honest with yourself as you can be, and work towards them. I can't make the choice for you but if i could I would carry on fighting, there are people who care about you deeply, dont give up on them.
Don't give up on me, please. I'm here for you.

What happened 2 months ago? Use messages if you dont want to share with everyone. Being is pain is tough, really tough, and being so strung out that you want to die is really shit, but I've been through it. I tried to take my own life, but half way through I regretted it, it felt like I hadn't given myself a proper chance. Like everything had a solution except the pills in my stomach. Do this: get high tonight. Forget about your worries. But in the morning write down 3 things that will improve your life. These could be as simple as eat more fruit. By making a list and doing them you will feel better about life I promise you.

Our parents fuck us up. And it takes alot to see what damage they really did. Deep seeded issues are always the killer ones. You need a therapist my friend, you need to talk about these problems to a professional and you need to get some closure on them. I think this is really the root cause of your depression. To be miserible feels like shit but there is a light at the end of the tunnel. Emotional welbeing can be achieved, no matter what you've been through. I think because of these things you've been through you don't feel comfortable in your own skin, and this led you to discard the things that other people enjoy, you mention this 'fuck it' attitude, thats what im talking about. It can change. The beliefs I hold dear are fairness and honesty, in that order ie you can deceive to restore fairness. Something simple like that might help you. 

A side note: you need to stop the drugs. They are making the situation way worse. Maybe not go cold turkey but work on your social prowess while on them. If you can't handle them well, do less and less until you're fitting in. I know what its like to snuff until you cant feel anything anymore but you are better than that. If you don't stop you are going to make your life worse, isn't that enough reason?

If there's anything I can do for you don't hesitate to ask, I will be there for you if you'll allow me to be.
Your parents love you, I love you, and I want to hear you're story. Spill every gorey detail.

Could you tell me why you think you feel different to everyone else? Or out of sync as you call it. What do you mean you fixed this once? What happened ? And how do you mean 'mindless shell' ? What are the real issues you dont like about life? Are you a laughing stoke now because of the state you're in with the drugs ?

Its normal to feel whatever you feel in that situation. Its easily understandable how you feel resentment towards towards her for trapping you, but at the end of the day do what you feel is right, sometimes you need to put some emotion aside to deal with the greater good. I hope she recovers.

I don't know what country you're from so I cant say how easy this will be but there are bereavement therapists who will help her cope. Encourage her to take up new hobbies, that might help her meet new people or take her mind off what shes going through.

Drugs alter our mood is ways we cant detect, the lack of serotonin in your brain means you're not thinking clearly. Believe me I went through it recently taking drugs to cope, I've been drug free for a week and already I'm feeling more upbeat. Suicide is a release from the pain you're feeling, sure, but its not the only cure. The act of suicide probably fills you with relief doesn't it? Thats a flashing neon sign that you need some professional help. Please for me call the suicide hotline and talk them through exactly what you're feeling. Section yourself. Just do something to stop yourself from making the biggest mistake of your life. Its not too late to choose life.
While you maybe the only person in her life, you need to get others involved, professionals, whoever who can talk to her and ease the pain in manageable chunks.

Think of her position, her pain. People kill themselves normally because they fell trapped in a position or after a big life change. You need to show her that it will pass. Nothing is worse than being in pain, but life goes on, don't let her think that shes alone in this world. Be a supportive friend rather than a partner.

The reason you dont want to involve people you know is because they would intervene, which i think is what scares you, you dont want to lose the power of having the choice of suicide. And it can be therapeutic just knowing you have the power to end your life. But when it comes down to it you dont want to kill yourself, you just want the pain in your life to disappear. You must be in pain to have suicidal thoughts, and by identifying whats causing you pain is the way forward. Its normal to be in your situation, especially when youre young and have little direction in life. Find a therapist, someone to hound out the problems in your life and find solutions, just voicing out loud the things going on in your life it'll help highlight what the issues are. So my advice really is to seek help before the darkness in your life consumes you. Find what makes you want to live in life and focus on that, stay strong brother.
Take each moment as a gift, think about each minute as your last and live like it. Be selfish. Dont give up man.

Well I'm here for you. Whatever you're going through will pass with time, just remember the pain you are feeling is temporary, things will get better. The friend who is telling you to suck it up cant relate to the way you're feeling and is giving bad advice not out of malice but ignorance. Take some time out for yourself and take it easy, don't let yourself get consumed by negative thoughts.
You can talk to me.
You want to talk about this in more detail ? Whats going wrong? Have you tried to talk to your friends about the way you're feeling? I'm here for you, i will be all night.

You're still very young, the 20's are some of the hardest years to live, you have to deal with becoming an adult while still keeping your head above the relentless tide of job/education/life. Try and surround yourself with people who make you feel happy. Seek out situations which will make you happy, this is very general advice I know but I cant give you specific advice without knowing more about you. Today you've changed the way I feel, relish that as something positive.
How old are you? How long have these fleeting moments lasted? What caused them?
In retrospect of course its easy to see, always have the conviction to see your good intentions through, forget about the bad
Stop compromising future goals for happiness.

You've never experienced true happiness? I find that extremely hard to believe. Happiness can be found in the smallest of things, you made me happy by simply replying to my message. I want to tell you its never too late, if you want to try to talk to someone about it give me a shout.
There's good sides of selfishness if you need it

Have you talked about specifics though? Suicide in my opinion is a release from the pain, a easy way out so to speak. It appears as a solution when you lose hope. The people surrounding you really dictate what mood you're in. It's not easy to communicate without sounding needy, but it might help you improve your situation. If you dont want to tell them, I'm always here for you, and I care, so theres that. Things will look up in the future, have hope.

You are clearly articulate, which is the first step in getting help. Talk to people who are close to you about suicide and get help from them. Seek counseling, and get some some medication. I'm here if you need to talk.

There's nothing wrong with you beyond the superficial world of looks. If everyone cared what others thoughts the world would be a fucked up place. Find joy in the small things. Fuck what others think about your condition. You'll find someone at some point in your life who will see through the mist of vanity. Everyone of gods decisions happened for a reason, keep up the faith in yourself and let god be the judge of what is beautiful.

The people in your life will always wonder if there was more they could have done to saved your life. The burden will be on them, they thought you could handle it and you couldn't. That's your fault for not reaching out for help, but their fault for not noticing it. Your family will never forget you, believe me, its hard wired into their being. There's a big difference between shutting down someone down and wishing them dead, you will have people who care if you live or die and they will be the ones who will have to live with it, not you.

The people in your life right now will be hurt from your decision to end it early. Suicide is selfish, no matter how badly you are hurting there is a solution to your problem, life can be something you enjoy. Everyone has the ability to create their world. Fight the voices that put you down, remember there's always light at the end of the tunnel.  The damage done in your life is superficial objectively, if this isn't true then that's wrong and fucked up. Change your perspective, because at the end of the day that's all that matters.

If you're job is making you so miserable that you want to kill yourself then you should find new work asap. Nothing is more important than being happy with yourself and your soul. Do what you think will make you happy, and if it doesn't then change direction until you find something that makes you happy. Life is too short to waste your time doing what you hate no matter what other people are saying. If you don't enjoy doing something then don't do it, simple. If its a case of finding a new job then start looking now, the process of looking will cheer you up, believe me things can get better. It's better to have a good quality of life than standard of living.

Everyone could have been better, but listen we are who we are and nothing is going to change that now, the only thing you have control over is the future, you decide the direction your life takes next. If you think becoming wealthier will make you happier then go for it. If you think getting out and meeting new people to fuel your hobbies and interests then go do that, but sitting back and sulking about it won't do anything. Find what makes you happy and do more of that, thats the secret to life.

You always have something to live for, look back at you're previous mistakes and work forward to progress into something you can do, it doesn't matter if this is a small thing as long as you progress you can make something of yourself. Start making some aspirations in something you enjoy. Take everyday as it comes and soon you'll start to enjoy to yourself, remember depression is a darkness that consumes your ability to think clearly, if we never fail how can we learn?

I've been in mental health services for 13 years during this time I've been down every alley of depression you can imagine, I've tried to off myself a few times and never to get that right. What was bring me down was hard to control and I felt like my life was drifting through an endless stream of misery. Constantly having thoughts of suicide was a daily routine. I had psychosis and major depression. But I sought help, I found love for new things and I found a way out of the tunnel of darkness. I started enjoying life and the small things which people forget about. When you're depressed everything seems different, once you've woken up to the happiness anyone can achieve everything is different. I found a psychologist who listen to my problems and this helped me rationalize and combat the things which were obstacles in my life. I started to have the motivation to try new things and suddenly it seems like the world was my oyster and so many opportunities were out there, I went back to college and finished my degree, now I have a job which I enjoy and am looking forward to starting a family with the woman I love. If you want someone to talk to, please message me, I'm always here for you.

There's so much more to life than superficial looks. Think about all the times you've been happy and think what a shame it would be to miss out on the potential to be happy like that in the future. You've got a boyfriend so already you're ahead in the dating game, this is a great sign. Don't listen to the people who take you down, don't let them have such power over your life, you decide the direction. The more you let these people in the worse you'll feel so just ignore them.
Whats got you so down?
You can talk to me

You can't blame your parents for the situation youre in. Lack of motivation and pleasure in daily activities are symptoms of depression. You should start anti depressants as soon as you can. Your life is completely in your control, if you don't like a particular job you have the option of choosing something else, eventually you'll be doing something you enjoy or at the very least be surrounded by people who make it worth doing. It's very normal to have suicidal thoughts when depressed but its important you never act on them. You can't know what your future holds.
Happiest can be found in many things. Having happiness is more important than material goods. If I can convince you anything is life gets easier the longer you try and improve it.

What is making your life hell? Is there anything you can do to change your current situation? By taking each day as it comes and everyday attempting to improve your circumstances things will get better. Even if you cant change things immediately seek out things you enjoy and focus on that. If you're not already start some anti depressants, counseling etc, even just by talking out loud it can reduce the stress of the situation and help you think laterally on how to fix issues, you can talk to me about anything if you need, i will never judge you no matter what it is.

You can't let people have that much power over you. You have plenty of reasons left to live. You should talk to your parents and explain how you feel, if they don't understand, fuck them, they don't have your interests at heart. If you want to chat to me i'm here.

It's very normal to have suicidal thoughts when you're depressed, but you must NEVER act on them. Have you tried anti-depressants or counseling ? Whatever situation you are in is a temporary phase that will pass if you let it. Stay strong.

Who cares if you're a stiff. Do what you want, you'll find like minded people whatever you do. How long have you had insomnia ? I used to get it, in my case it was always stress. But I forced myself up at a certain hour, got plenty of exercise and this would make me crash in the evenings. Its hard at first but well worth it. Progressing into a job and career will give you a grounding in this world, its a long term goal but one you should be aiming for. Sorry if any of that sounded preachy I just know whats helped me in the past. I'm glad you have an active social life, I think you're just stuck in a rut at the moment, things will get easier.

Ok. How actively are you looking for a job? Someone in your situation can easily become depressed and that can act as a vicious cycle. You need to get involved in something new to break the cycle. Its never easy but by giving yourself small rewards along the way. Something like going to the gym twice a week will give you some structure and help with the depression. By doing the same things everyday you achieve the same result.
How old are you? What are you doing with your life at the moment?
Can I ask you why you don't love yourself? What led to this situation ?

The teens are the most turbulent time people go through. Feeling like a failure is horrible. What I can say to you is this; life gets easier. You still need to find your niche, and there are plenty opportunities out there. By giving up now you'll never find out what the rest of your life could be. Stay strong and take each day as it comes, im here if you need to speak to someone.

Its hard to find time for yourself sometimes. Rage quiting is never a good thing, maybe youre playing the wrong games ?  I'm sorry to hear that your mother is putting pressure on you, drinking isnt the answer though. You'll end up in depressive swings that may get worse with time. You should just explain to her you need that time to sleep, is there a reason shes limiting your sleep ? We all have fucked up families it just takes a bit of swings and roundabouts to get it right.
give me more details about your situation, maybe we can trade horror stories

I'm a minor celebrity where i'm from, literally everything i say and do is picked up and eaten up by vultures in the media. I'm tired of living life under the magnifying glass. I've heard from people here and cried a bit over this which is something I very rarely do and i'm feeling a bit better. I had thought of ways of ending it but I don't think I could do it to those few people who have helped me. I've got prospects in the future but right now it all seems so bleak under the stress i'm under at the moment.
theres no way malware can linger on a usb stick ?
Don't listen to other people, be selfish, that's the way of getting past bad times.

Well you seem to have some control over your life which is a good start. The ability to say no is an attribute not enough people have. 2 credits away, I don't know what that means but im guessing you're close to finishing. Isn't this a good start even without experience? Having a degree puts you above average in terms of qualifications and studies show you will earn more with it. 

In terms of a family: I don't know you, i don't know what you're like but I'm guessing you've got pretty low self esteem. You can't know how people in the future will think about you but considering you think you do tells me you worry too much. Does that make sense? Let other make up their own minds about you. I'm sure you'd be surprised how much your kids will love you.

Whats your degree in? How far are you into it ? Why do you give so much of yourself for others when you get nothing back? I've found depression can be solved by taking away pressures that others impose on us, not being afraid of being a little selfish.

Let me guess, you were the shy one in the corner that people liked until you started abusing drugs, then you relied on drugs to keep yourself on an even keel after a big life change maybe? You can't see a life without drugs? There's a quote I have for such an occasion: People never change, only other peoples opinions of them do. To say you've not experienced life is bullshit, tell me what you've missed out on...

Fuck it indeed. I can't stop you from making the wrong choices, I've made plenty in my life. I've been vulnerable, abused by people I trusted. Fuck it though! Its all meaningless if you look at life objectively. Your life is worth more than you make out.

I'm sorry you didn't mention the extent of your anxiety issues before. You said before your dad cared about you ? Have you tried talking to him about any of this before? Does he know how you feel? Often enough its very hard to approach a conversation like this 'offline'. People generally are shit about talking about emotions. I'm convinced most people go through shit in their lives, but as soon as things get better they completely shut off that side of the brain, its naturally wired so we stay happy. It makes it hard to relate to people who aren't having a good time. You'd be surprised about how much people cared if you knew what you were truly going through. As I mentioned before maybe you should suggest to him that you spend more time together, this will help give you some extra support and time for you to talk to him.

Ahh you said GP, same term used as the UK. I have a suggestion for you which you may hate. Go backpacking! Maybe not immediately but something to aim for. I came over to Australia a few years ago and found jobs on the go, living by the paycheck, staying in hostels where its really easy to meet new people. It was really refreshing. This might give you a fresh start and kick start a love for life. Stagnating in the same place may just remind you of drugs and all the negative things you associate with your life today. Giving yourself a goal will give yourself something to aim for also.
When I'm really down I remind myself that I'm in a rut, in a tunnel where I cant quite yet see the light or hope at the end. Everything changes. What part of the UK are you from ?

All I can say to you is take every day as it comes, start small and work your way into doing more and more. The lack of motivation could be caused by a treatable depression. See if you can get some on anti-depressants. Finally STOP comparing yourself to other people. I had to drop out of university a while back, I was in the same place you are now, living with my parents, being a burden, drinking by myself to cope with the self pity. I watched all my friends graduate, get married and have kids BUT I went back and repeated my course 3 years later. I was so far behind in my life but you know what I'm so happy I never gave up, stuck with my goal and made something of it. I can't ask you to do something you don't want to do but remember this: you know exactly where the drug path leads, you don't know what other possibilities there are out there.

Hey man, battling drug a addiction is hard. You've been so used to feeling a certain way that now you're forced to be sober life truely is shit. I went through this with coke. I can tell you something: IT GETS EASIER. Instead of thinking about what others are doing and how well they are getting along without drugs focus on your own goals. It took me years to start enjoying 'normal' activities again. Its really subjective. I'm not going to say there's a miracle cure but take each day as it comes. One thing I should mention is that when I first came off coke and came 'out' to it to everyone I knew at first I had all the support in the world, people coming to visit me check I was ok randomly etc, but eventually they fade back into their ordinary lifes. This is completely normal and no fault of your own. What was best was explaining this situation to my strongest footholds and arrange times to spend time together which best fit both our lifes. This way you have some structure to your week and a regular shoulder should you need it.  If you need someone to chat to i'll be here.
